Android does not allow apps to reactivate their own accessibility service. On the next screen, select Back Button Hero, switch it off, then switch it on again. This safely clears a stopped or crashed service without changing your assignments.

Normally, the regular setup of Back Button Hero is all you need. Only when a particular app needs a gesture or button for itself can an explicit exception be necessary – that is exactly what this page is for. The app on the screen with controller focus decides; unchecked actions behave there as if Back Button Hero were not installed.

Before first use, place the handheld on a stable surface and tap Calibrate. Leave it untouched for about 4 seconds; it does not need to be level. Movement delays the measurement (up to 20 seconds). Then pick it up and turn the gyro off/on, or press its hold button, to set your playing posture as the middle. Tap the preview to centre again without recalibrating.
